content.text:
Plan submitted — all 18 rules searched and assigned candidate locations.

**Highlights for the reviewing workers:**

- **Likely deviations to prioritise:** IP ownership of Developed Software (p0185, M&I owns what we pay for); the paid Termination for Convenience/Cause Fees and their liquidated-damages validation (p0187, p0189, p0208, tied to Estimated Remaining Value p0039); the flat no-assignment clause (p0289) with no affiliate/successor carve-out for us; the M&I liability cap and direct-damages-only regime (p0198, p0207); the capitalised warranty disclaimer against the §9/§16.1 warranties (p0236); and 21.11 Future Acquisitions as a de facto exclusivity restriction (p0281, p0282).
- **Absent:** MFN (no responsive language) and, on current evidence, any non-compete on us.
- **Runs in our favour (do not flag):** Customer Data ownership (p0243), regulatory/audit access and M&I's data-centre review (p0274–p0277), M&I financial statements (p0300), disaster termination without penalty (p0263), no termination fee on M&I default (p0190).
- **Noted, not deviations, pending worker read:** Wisconsin law/Milwaukee venue (p0286–p0287) as an accepted-but-not-preferred forum, and the Termination Assistance clause sitting near the fallback (p0192, at our expense, no express data-return-in-usable-format duty).
